title: Card draft
description: The Game Designer's answer to a Draft a game card run: one new seed-1 game card. The estimate is also the card's funding target. The dispatcher fills in the bucket (game) and the folder (seed-1), resolves the executor's name to an active, unpaused writer role, and runs the checks before the Game Director grades it.

title.description: What changes, in a few plain words.

summary.description: The public summary a supporter reads: one plain sentence, all-ages, that the check lines back.

intent.description: The brief the builder reads: what to change and why.

acceptance_test.description: Plain lines, then one or more machine lines of the form check: config <file> <path> == <json>, each false on main today and true once the card is built.

lane.description: config changes JSON under seed-1/config or seed-1/content only; code changes seed-1 outside the kernel paths.

executor.description: The name of the writer role that builds it, from the list the prompt gives.

estimate_usd.description: What the card should cost to build, which is also its funding target, in dollars to at most four decimal places (at least 0.0001).
